title: Auto-Invest Adds Arbitrum Portfolio and ARB, GMX, MAGIC, GNS Listings
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  ARB, GMX, MAGIC and GNS  are now supported for Auto-Invest plans.  Users may now purchase any of these tokens with a Single Token Plan or a Portfolio Plan. The  “Top 4 Arbitrum Tokens on Auto-Invest”  Portfolio, which users may opt for in the Pre-set Selection section, also allows users to purchase ARB, GMX, MAGIC and GNS seamlessly via the same Auto-Invest plan. [Set Up an Auto-Invest Plan Now!] How to Create an Auto-Invest Plan: Open the  Binance App , and tap  [More]  >  [Earn]  >  [Auto-Invest] . Alternatively, you may access Auto-Invest via the website  here . Tap  [Subscribe] , and decide whether you want to create a Single Token Plan or Portfolio Plan.  Select the asset(s) you want to buy, and choose whether you wish to purchase your desired cryptocurrencies with  USDT  or  BUSD . Select the recurring cycle for the Auto-Invest Plan.  Click  [Confirm]  to subscribe. Tip:  Please ensure that you have sufficient stablecoin balance in the Spot Wallet or Simple Earn Flexible Products to guarantee successful recurring purchases. [Set Up an Auto-Invest Plan Now!] About Auto-Invest: Auto-Invest is a dollar-cost averaging (DCA) investment strategy which allows you to automate crypto investment and earn passive income at the same time. Users may visit the  Auto-Invest FAQ  for more information. Thanks for your support!
